_comment: Sprite studio settings (see tools/sprite_studio.gd). kit_folder = where the 3D models are; output_folder = where the building pictures go. For each building id from data/buildings.json: model = file in the kit, turn = quarter turns (0-3) so its front faces the camera, tiles = how many tiles wide it stands (default: its size in data/buildings.json, else 1), kit_folder (optional) = look for this one model somewhere else, spin (optional) = a part that turns in the game: part = its name in the model (made with a pivot, art/blender/kit.py), frames = pictures per repeat, repeat_degrees = how far it turns before it looks the same again (120 for 3 blades), clockwise = as the player sees it, seconds_per_turn = one full turn in the game. Our own models are made in Blender by the scripts in art/blender/ and saved to art/models/ (how-to: art/README.md). The rest are TEMPORARY stand-ins from Kenney City Kit (Commercial) 2.1, CC0, https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial - not committed to Git; re-download into Sprites kit/ to re-run the studio on another computer.
